description: Source code for firmware upgrade hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions, including download, status, reboot, and reset operations.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_util_get_syscmd_output
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output.

methods.name: download_image_from_server
methods.description: Downloads firmware image from HTTP server to local storage.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_set_download_url
methods.description: Sets the URL and filename for firmware download.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_get_download_url
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware download URL and filename.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_set_download_interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface for firmware download (wan0 or erouter0).

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_get_download_interface
methods.description: Gets the network interface used for firmware download.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_download
methods.description: Initiates firmware download process, including hostname resolution and image download.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_get_download_status
methods.description: Returns current firmware download status or progress.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_reboot_ready
methods.description: Checks if device is ready to reboot after firmware update.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_download_reboot_now
methods.description: Performs reboot after firmware download, setting reboot reason.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_update_and_factoryreset
methods.description: Performs firmware update and factory reset sequence.

methods.name: fwupgrade_hal_download_install
methods.description: Placeholder for downloading and installing firmware from URL.
